biggest_catch: Only for new UHFCU members who open a new checking account within 90 days of establishing membership; the $100 comes as a Visa Reward Card (not cash) delivered 4-6 weeks after qualifying.
catches: Register in-branch or online at referlive.com/uhfcuoffers using promo code SCORE100.
Open a new UHFCU checking account within 90 days of establishing membership (new members only).
Within 60 days of account opening: complete five (5) UHFCU debit card purchases totaling at least $50, AND enroll in eStatements.
Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the $100 Visa Reward Card after completing all offer requirements.
One reward per account only; granted to primary owners only; primary owner must have a Social Security number on file.
Must be 18 years or older; membership eligibility requirements apply.
Accounts must be in good standing at the time of qualification and reward distribution.
Reward may be reported as income to the IRS; recipient is responsible for any federal, state, or local taxes.
May not be combined with any other offer; terms and conditions are subject to change at any time without notice.
